description: A single decisive directed spell-casting body action with no visible magic. Draw the empty right hand briefly to the right ribs while turning the waist, press forward with the front knee and extend that hand sharply toward the right, palm outward. Shoulder and elbow follow the waist. Left hand keeps the same crystal staff upright throughout. Brief recoil in the robe, then recover to original pose. No bright light, no particles, no staff swing or spinning. Preserve identity and body proportions in every frame. Both feet and all weapons remain fully inside canvas. Transparent surroundings, fixed camera.
subject_description: The identical adult blonde elf woman, lavender eyes, long wavy blonde hair, deep-neckline sleeveless white dress with silver waist knot, dark green robe over shoulders with silver trim, original long blue crystal staff. Preserve face, neckline, body and clothing exactly.
initial_pose: Standing with crystal staff angled upward in left hand, empty right hand lowered
